title: Hyderabad court grants Union minister’s son interim bail in POCSO case
description: A city court in Hyderabad has granted interim bail to Bandi Sai Bageerath, son of Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar, in a case registered under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, reported PTI.The relief was granted to enable Bageerath to sit for his BBA examinations.
